      "component": "Order history lookup tool",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "The agent uses an LLM with tool calling to look up order history, which contains email addresses and shipping address." },
        { "quote": "\"exposure\":\"public\",\"llmFeatures\":true,\"fileUpload\":false,\"auth\":false" }
      ],
      "asvs": [],
      "cwe": ["CWE-639", "CWE-862"],
      "plainLanguage": "Someone could ask the chatbot about an order that is not theirs and get the other person's email and address.",

        "title": "Order lookups scoped to the authenticated customer",
        "given": "an authenticated customer session in the mobile app",
        "when": "the agent invokes the order history tool with any order identifier",

      }

      "stride": "ElevationOfPrivilege",
      "title": "$200 refund cap enforced only in the prompt, so it can be exceeded or repeated",

      "component": "Refund tool to Stripe payment API",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "The agent can issue refunds up to $200 through the Stripe payment API." }

      }

      }

        "then": "an append-only record links the Stripe refund id, authenticated customer id, order id, amount, conversation id and the transcript turns and rules that justified it, retained for dispute handling"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "InformationDisclosure",
      "title": "Customer PII sent to the external LLM provider beyond what the turn needs",

      "asvs": [],
      "cwe": ["CWE-359"],
      "plainLanguage": "Customer emails and addresses get sent to an outside AI service; only the minimum should go, and it must not be kept.",

        "title": "Minimised and redacted context to the model provider",
        "given": "the agent needs order information to answer a question",
        "when": "context is assembled for the LLM call",
        "then": "only fields needed for the current turn are included, email and full address are masked unless required, and the provider is contractually configured for zero retention and no training on the data"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "DenialOfService",
      "title": "Unauthenticated public chat lets anyone burn model and Stripe capacity",
      "scenario": "The agent is reachable from the public mobile app with no login, and each turn costs paid LLM inference plus tool and Stripe calls.         "given": "a client calling the agent endpoint",
        "when": "message volume, token spend or tool calls exceed per-session, per-customer and global thresholds",
        "then": "further requests are rejected with a clear message and a hard budget ceiling stops model and Stripe calls before the service or budget is exhausted"
      }
    }
